pages.text: Not every world needs the Black Death. Whenever the Pestilence climbs a phase, whoever keeps the world (an operator, or the host of a single-player world) is offered a choice: $(6)[Halt the Pestilence here]$().$(br2)Take it, and the plague never climbs past that phase. Rats, sickness and the Afflicted stay, but nothing worse comes.

pages.title: Commands
pages.text: $(l)/pestilence halt$() stops it at the current phase, $(l)/pestilence halt <phase>$() at any phase, and $(l)/pestilence resume$() lets it climb again.$(br2)The bell also warns you which phase comes next, so you are never caught unaware.

pages.title: Presets
pages.text: The config offers three presets.$(br)$(2)Vanilla+$(): a lighter plague that stops at Outbreak, grows at half pace and spawns less.$(br)$(l)Standard$(): as written in this book.$(br)$(4)Grim$(): faster and more contagious, and the sick never get better on their own.
